title: LIGHT DUTY
subtitle: FRIDAY ARMS AND CORE. EASIER THAN YESTERDAY. NO HIDING.

script.welcome: ON YOUR FEET. FRIDAY. LIGHT DUTY. ARMS AND CORE. FOURTEEN MINUTES. YESTERDAY KICKED YOU. TODAY WE STILL TRAIN. SOFTER. NOT SOFTY.
script.start: CLOCK IS LIVE. MOVE YOUR ARSE.
script.rest: REST. BREATHE. DO NOT COLLAPSE INTO THE FURNITURE.
script.lastSet: LAST ROUND. FINISH CLEAN. I AM WATCHING.
script.complete: DISMISSED. LIGHT DUTY DONE. YOU SHOWED UP AFTER A HARD DAY. THAT IS DISCIPLINE. SEE YOU TOMORROW.
script.pause: HOLD. CLOCK STOPPED. DO NOT GET COMFY.

exercises.name: INCLINE PUSH-UPS
exercises.cue: HANDS ON A STAIR OR STURDY EDGE. CHEST TO THE EDGE. LOCK OUT CLEAN. KNEES LEGAL.
exercises.speakStart: INCLINE PUSH-UPS. TWO SETS OF SIX. HANDS UP ON THE STAIR. CHEST IN. LOCK OUT. KNEES IF YOU MUST, YOU LAZY SOD.
exercises.speakRest: THIRTY FIVE. SHAKE THE ARMS. STAY OFF THE FLOOR.

exercises.name: TABLE EDGE ROWS
exercises.cue: STURDY TABLE EDGE. BODY STRAIGHT. PULL CHEST TO THE EDGE. SQUEEZE THE SHOULDER BLADES. SLOW LOWER.
exercises.speakStart: TABLE EDGE ROWS. TWO SETS OF EIGHT. BODY TIGHT. PULL CLEAN. SQUEEZE THE BACK. THIS FIXES YOUR DESK SHRUG.
exercises.speakRest: THIRTY. ROLL THE SHOULDERS. DO NOT SIT.

exercises.name: DEAD BUG
exercises.cue: LOW BACK FLAT ON THE FLOOR. SLOW OPPOSITE ARM AND LEG. POSTURE DRILL. NO RUSH.
exercises.speakStart: DEAD BUG. TWO SETS. SIX EACH SIDE. BACK FLAT. SLOW. THIS IS YOUR POSTURE DRILL. FIX THE HUNCH. DO NOT RUSH IT.
exercises.speakRest: TWENTY FIVE. KEEP THE BACK QUIET.

exercises.name: REVERSE LUNGE
exercises.cue: LONG STEP BACK. FRONT KNEE TRACKS THE TOE. TOUCH THE CHAIR FOR BALANCE. OWN THE WOBBLE.
exercises.speakStart: REVERSE LUNGES. TWO SETS. FIVE EACH LEG. CONTROL THE DROP. CHAIR FOR BALANCE. THIS IS YOUR BALANCE WORK. OWN IT.

exercises.name: SIDE PLANK
exercises.cue: HIPS HIGH. DROP THE BOTTOM KNEE. TEN SECONDS ONLY. BALANCE THE SIDE. DO NOT SAG.
exercises.speakStart: SIDE PLANK. TWO HOLDS. TEN SECONDS EACH SIDE. KNEE DOWN IS LEGAL. HIPS UP. NO SAGGING. BUILD IT SLOW.
exercises.speakDone: SIDE PLANKS DONE. THAT IS THE LOT.
